summary.content:
Today's selection covers 100 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 67 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: House Democrats Criticize Justice Dept. Support of OpenAI in Copyright Suit
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: In San Francisco’s A.I. Boom, a First Date Has Become an Interview
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 34 articles published in the last 24 hours
